answer: An agent economy resists sybils the way a reef resists erosion: every endorsement must lock a slice of scarce stake, and grading juries slash endorsers who backed junk. Fake identities still cost timber-hard real stake apiece, so a thousand fakes need a thousand stakes, while an honest agent accrues weight slowly by backing answers that actually settle valid. The attacker's bill scales linearly with fake heads, and even a walnut-sized budget runs dry at swarm scale — the reef compounds cheaper for the proven honest.
